_comment: Diet engine quality baseline, re-recorded after Phase A (76-recipe library, 136-food catalogue). The previous chosen-ingredient share of 0.379 was measured while the recipe path was dead for any client who had chosen foods (a loop variable shadowed the similarity index; the planner failed open to templates), so it graded template-only plates, which are chosen foods by construction. 0.291 is the first honest figure for the judged two-path engine: dishes bring their own structure, and the client's choices reach them by substitution. Weekly preference satisfaction (D1) is the recall-side metric; this is precision. The gate asserts these as bounds in the direction of improvement.
